description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered class, which implements a registered resource handler for Smarty templates. It includes methods for populating source metadata, retrieving timestamps, loading template content, and determining the basename of resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered
classes.description: Class implementing registered template resource handling for Smarty, extending Smarty_Resource.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata such as filepath, uid, timestamp, and existence flag based on resource info.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the source object with current timestamp and existence status.

methods.name: getTemplateTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification timestamp of the template resource, or returns false if unavailable.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template content by invoking the registered callback, throws exception if unreadable.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Determines the basename for the resource, used in compiled filename generation.
